messages.subject: Banpu Power | Power transition, regional growth and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Niropas and Banpu Power Leadership Team,

Your own career across mining, project development and power generation makes Banpu Power an especially relevant organization for my background. I have built my executive experience on the same boundary between resource operations, energy systems and institutional execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. I lead government and regulatory engagement, ESG coordination, social performance and senior stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation.

My recent work includes governance and external support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, along with carbon-data readiness using physical operating records. I also coordinate permits, inspections, official engagements, community priorities and cross-functional corrective actions. This gives me a grounded perspective on the stakeholder side of power transition and regional project delivery.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or international roles in External Affairs, ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership or regional stakeholder strategy. I have attached a Banpu Power-focused executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
